title: Two Mothers (HKLGFF 2026)
synopsis: At the age of 57, Rosa von Praunheim's 94-year-old mother told him a secret that rewrote his life: he was adopted. Only after the death of Gertrud, the woman who raised the enfant terrible of German cinema with unconditional love, did he dare to look for his biological mother, armed with little more than the name of a Riga children's home. What unfolds is a detective story through the darkest chapter of European history, leading through the archives of Nazi-occupied Latvia and the spectre of SS eugenics to a birth certificate discovered in a prison hospital, and to a biological mother whose fate proves devastating. Germany's great provocateur turns the camera unflinchingly on himself and finds his most tender register: part whodunit, part reckoning with the Second World War, and above all a love letter to the mother who chose him. TWO MOTHERS was a jury award nominee at Tribeca.
